summary: Marion County, OR ground site with a cabin built in 1940; the register and firelookout.com say it is gone, and no source describes what remains.

facts.design: Cabin on a ground site (no tower)
facts.status_note: Register and firelookout.com say the cabin is gone; the Oregon Forest Lookouts page says removed; no source gives a removal year

events.note: Cabin built on the site (ground site)
Registered September 20, 2010 as FFLOS US 650, OR 82, nominated by Ray Kresek

evidence.supports: a cabin was built in 1940 and is now gone
evidence.quote: A cabin was built in 1940 and is now gone.

evidence.supports: site in the Mount Hood region of Marion County
the Clackamas-Marion Fire Patrol Association is named for the site
the Oregon Forest Lookouts page marks the site as removed
the register places the site in Marion County
the Oregon Forest Lookouts page names the site Duro (Sweet Springs Mtn)

notes_for_editor: Thin record: three short lookout pages and one search that turned up nothing new. No source gives a removal year or describes the site now. The agency field is a fire patrol association, not a federal agency. Brief's coordinates (44.85598, -122.4605) match the register.
